title: Sonic Adventure/Big the Cat
text:
right|250px

 Objective 
Froggy accidentally swallowed Chaos's Tail and now is trying to run away! 
Bring him back with your fishing rod.

 Controls 

Action Stages
 Twinkle Park
 Ice Cap
 Emerald Coast
 Hot Shelter

 Bosses 
 Chaos 6

 Upgrades 
 Lifebelt 
Allows Big to float upwards when in water. Found in the Ice Cave.
 Power Fishing Rod 
Allows your cast to fly farther. Found under Big's bed in the rainforest.
 Fishing Lures 
Fishing Lure 1: Stronger fishing line. Found in the 3rd rainforest cave.
Fishing Lure 2: Stronger fishing line. In sewer. (Next to Twinkle Park)
Fishing Lure 3: Stronger fishing line. Icecap Action Stage next to the dinosaur skeleton.
Fishing Lure 4: Stronger fishing line. In prison cell on the 'Egg Carrier'.
